title: data/repos.yaml
description: Desired state for each repository. This file holds INTENT, not observed GitHub state: no stars, no 'current_*' mirrors. Live state is fetched at diff time, so the file never churns and a diff is always against reality rather than a stale copy.

description.description: One line: what the thing IS and what it is FOR. No marketing. Lead with the generic phrasing, not the coined name.

topics.description: 3-8 GitHub topics, or empty. Omit rather than guess: a wrong topic misleads retrieval. Padding is keyword stuffing.

homepage.description: Published site for this repo, or its paper page. Writes are deferred while the target does not exist yet.

kind.description: Decides the treatment. See docs/REPOS.md -- guide and paper-code get different READMEs, and only paper-code gets CITATION.cff.

generic_gloss.description: For a coined name, the plain phrase someone would actually search for. Empty when the name is already descriptive.

paper_slug.description: Slug in data/papers.yaml, when this repo backs a paper.

write_citation_cff.description: Generate CITATION.cff from the paper's verbatim BibTeX. Only meaningful with a paper_slug.

write_links_block.description: Maintain a generated links block in the README, between paper-geo markers, carrying the paper's full link set.

reviewed.description: A human has checked this entry. Freezes it permanently against future model proposals.

llm_proposal.description: Raw model output, kept for audit. Promoted into the fields above only when reviewed is false.

_deferred.description: Machine-written: changes withheld this run, with the reason.
